reviews.comments:
El departamento está bien conectado, cerca de vialidades importantes y varios negocios. La seguridad del edificio es buena, y el personal de vigilancia es muy amable. El edificio es silencioso y se puede descansar bien. Mercedes es muy amable, atenta y dispuesta a resolver asuntos que se presenten con el alojamiento. La regadera tiene muy buena presión de agua y excelente temperatura, la cama es cómoda y hay sábanas y toallas extra (lo que siempre viene bien para estancias largas, como fue nuestro caso). La cocina está bien para preparar desayunos y meriendas sencillas.
El wifi no es de módem fijo, sino portátil (tipo celular que hay que recargar), funciona para revisar el correo y ver alguna serie, pero no para conexiones en línea (Zoom, GoogleMeets, etc). El departamento es cómodo pero requiere de una pintada urgente; debido a la humedad de la ciudad ya tiene humedades y hongos importantes en el techo del baño y las paredes del cuarto y la sala.

localizedReview.comments:
The apartment is well connected, close to major roads and several businesses. The building's security is good, and the security staff are very friendly. The building is quiet and you can rest well. Mercedes is very friendly, attentive and willing to resolve issues that arise with the accommodation. The shower has very good water pressure and excellent temperature, the bed is comfortable and there are extra sheets and towels (which is always good for long stays, as was our case). The kitchen is good for preparing simple breakfasts and snacks.
The Wi-Fi is not a fixed modem, but portable (cell phone type that you have to recharge), it works to check email and watch some series, but not for online connections (Zoom, GoogleMeets, etc). The apartment is comfortable but requires an urgent paint job; due to the humidity of the city, it already has significant dampness and mold on the bathroom ceiling and the walls of the bedroom and living room.

I spent a week at Mercedes' condo, and had a decent experience. Check-in and check-out were fast and easy, and the unit was very clean when I arrived. The location is perfect if you'd like to be outside the tourist areas - It's right between Miraflores, San Isidro and downtown, in a very local area with great food and lots of energy (walk straight down to Arenales for a whole block of restaurants with great lunch specials!). Both the building and the area felt safe and friendly.
The main issues were the Internet and the maintenance of the unit. The Internet is a portable hotspot, and although I didn't need much speed, it was very unreliable and slowed down a lot - Even compared to tethering on my phone. The kitchen faucet leaked, and the toilet seat came off on the second day. Part of the covering on the living room chairs even peeled off when I sat on them. Mercedes was a kind and responsive host, so I assume she tried to fix these things for future guests. Still, I had a good stay.
